immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: resetForNewScope() is in the unconditional block of the effect at TerminalContainer.tsx:1111 and the production comment at :1125-1129 states the effect re-runs on callback identity change. A third reset path (:2342) was omitted. Decision doc §3 restated.

Verified at TerminalAuthorityProductionAdapter.ts:1990: start + all chunks + commit go out in one batch, so rejection at checkpoint-start does not avoid transmission. 'Outcome-neutral' was false. Rationale rewritten; deferral now rests on the approval gate alone.

Verified by new measurement: at 200 columns, 8 SGR runs/line reaches only 63.7%; only per-token density crosses. Density is a precondition. Added a density sweep (raw/density-*.jsonl) and qualified §1/§4.3.
Correct: browserWouldReject is a hand-copy; the coordinator is never imported. Relabelled in the test file and in §5.3 rather than claiming execution.
Correct: truncated is a hardcoded literal, so the case pins a declaration. Title and comment corrected.
Correct: 600-line sample extrapolated 16.7x while validation used 1500. Raised SAMPLE_LINES to 1500 and directly measured the 200-column gate geometry (5,131,000 B vs 5,127,582 projected, 0.067%).
Correct: commit field was the placeholder '(pending)'. Backfilled per the 837cba1 precedent.

Correct that the cost claim was imprecise: the trigger is a read of resourceLimits.* in non-test server/src, not observation as such. §5.2 now states that and says why the zero-cost variant closes the telemetry gap rather than the admission gap.
Correct and well aimed: AC-4 was used as a veto without asking whether it still holds. Added §6.0 as a reported-not-repaired entry.
Correct. Replaced the rounded '~170' with a directly measured bracket: 166 col = 99.998%, 168 col = 101.4%, crossover 167.
Correct: 358cb2c changed no hashes. Recorded in §8 as instructed rather than rewriting history.
Correct: raw/.gitignore was the one unhashed committed file and is exactly the artifact whose earlier content dropped evidence. Added to SHA256SUMS.
Correct: no suite ran the file. Added server script test:checkpoint-mint-size following the test:authority-pin convention, and disclosed it in §5.3/§9.
Correct: -unavailable covers seven causes, not three. #28 handoff widened.

rejected.rationale: Conclusion accepted, suggested fix rejected. The reviewer proposed making the harness import via a relative path into server/src so it runs in place. That was tried before the harness was written this way and fails at module resolution: 'TypeError: Cannot destructure property SerializeAddon of import_addon_serialize.default as it is undefined' at headlessTerminal.ts:12, when run with cwd=server/ from a file outside server/src. The limitation is therefore recorded in §8 with that exact error rather than papered over with a fix that does not work.
